literal: Impartiality he-who-possesses's prosperity, destruction without, to descendants protection it-has.
translation: The prosperity of a man of impartial justice will never perish, but will serve as a secure protection for his descendants.
modern: நடுவுநிலைமை உடையவனுடைய செல்வமானது அழிவில்லாமல் அவனுடைய சந்ததியினருக்கும் பாதுகாப்பாக அமையும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the enduring nature of wealth earned through fairness. The word 'ceppam' refers to rectitude or impartiality. While ill-gotten wealth might seem to grow, the prosperity ('ākkam') of a just person is unique because it suffers no destruction ('citaivu iṉṟi'). Instead, it leaves a lasting legacy, providing security ('ēmāppu') to their descendants ('eccam', literally 'that which is left behind').
